text_description: Full-length runway look in a very dark navy-black palette, built around a long, minimalist knit tunic worn over matching loose trousers. The upper garment has a clean crew neckline, long narrow sleeves, relaxed dropped or softly shaped shoulders, and a straight elongated body that falls past the hips to around knee level, with a subtle ribbed or finished hem band visible near the lower edge. Fine seam lines or paneling are visible across the upper chest and shoulder area, giving the otherwise plain surface a restrained geometric structure. The silhouette is lean through the torso but not tight, with the long top creating a vertical column over fuller, fluid trousers that stack slightly over the shoes. The trousers are dark, wide-legged, and softly draped, partly obscured by the tunic above. Styling is spare and monochrome, finished with black rectangular sunglasses and dark rounded-toe shoes, producing a quiet, austere, modern ready-to-wear mood.
key_elements: subtle upper-body seam or panel lines
uncertainty_notes: Color reads as black or very deep navy depending on light
Knit texture is suggested by surface and ribbed edges but exact material is not identifiable
